POC scope: deliverable = air-gapped appliance image + install playbook + audit log forwarder that can export to their on-prem SIEM (Splunk). Must support customer-managed HSM (Luna/Thales) and local KMS with envelope encryption.

Security review highlights:
- CISO: 'we cannot allow key escrow; all keys must be under our HSM control'
- Data residency: all model context and KV cache must remain inside Crestwood network; no telemetry leaves without signed release

- Offline activation workflow for air-gapped installs (signed manifests, USB-attachable license token)
- Deterministic kernel set for inference runtime; reproducible SBOM and CVE scan report with each release
- Local-only model caching; fallback routing disabled by default; policy to enable fallback to dedicated hosted only after manual approval
- Support for custom network ACLs, strict egress deny-by-default, and manual upgrade process

- Procurement prefers multi-year committed capacity (reserved dedicated units) + add-on fee for on-prem install and validation
- Pricing ask: include separate line items for HSM integration, remote assistance (air-gapped via escorted jumpbox), and extended on-site validation windows
